validationProvenance.ios: The iOS runtime and focal-test blobs are byte-identical to Product SHA 29089031, which was bundled to the macOS VM, parsed by swiftc, linked as an iosX64 framework, built as an unsigned Intel Simulator host and ran the three selected XCTest methods successfully. The iOS matrix was not repeated for the Android-only runtime correction and Web test-name correction.
validationProvenance.diagnostic: The first Kotlin/Native link attempt ended with ld errno 28 because the VM system volume was full. The unchanged exact Product SHA passed after moving the isolated build and cache to /Volumes/QuataMigrationCapacity; this was an environment-capacity failure, not a product failure.

independentReviewCorrections: Android now clears the notification return marker when Chat is left through any route or authentication is lost, with focal negatives for both transitions.
